title: A Dedicated Day of Dali
text: Absolute amazing experience and what Noelia doesn’t know about Dali ) and Gala..!!) and how the art links with the local area. Noelia also puts Dali into local political context ( for that time) and allows you to come to your own conclusions. When we first entered the Dali Theatre Noelia explained what we were seeing, the historical contact ( including Gala’ death and the realisation of his mortality) we saw people come and go and Noelia still had knowledge to discuss and share. 100 % would say book this day ( and it is a full day)

title: Dali tour - a fantastic experience
text:
Up till this trip my knowledge on Dali was pretty limited.
Noelia was our guide and from the start she was brilliant. Her encyclopaedic knowledge on Dali the person and the artist and the local areas is unreal. Although it is a long day her energy and passion kept us engaged .  I would recommend Noelia 100% I have a newfound interest and respect for Dali

title: Marcelo is the best!!
